fusion.hyperposition: Faceted backend work preserves semantic HyperRelation identity while allowing verified physical lowering. Topology-scope work adds validity dependencies: a lowering/rewrite/cache artifact must also bind the topology planes it materially reads.
fusion.claycode: Attach TopologyReadEffect/CompiledTopologyScope to the same TypedIR/lowering lineage as HyperRelationIR -> HyperpositionLoweringPlan -> BackendArtifact; do not create a parallel semantic IR.
fusion.owner_fixed_native_state_runtime: TopologyReadEffect, topology fingerprints, generation fields and certificate identity must be ClayCode-native typed values across cognition -> TypedIR -> UnifiedDB/authority -> runtime lowering -> verified outcome/re-entry. Python/JSON is research/projection tooling only, never semantic authority.
fusion.claygraph: Derived topology fingerprints are rebuildable projection identities; mismatch can invalidate dependent derived work but match does not mint truth or causal credit.
fusion.unifieddb: Persist native certificate/read-effect values and lineage transactionally; do not reconstruct them from prompt text or sidecar metadata.
fusion.gwt: Target falsifier must measure selection/use/outcome/re-entry differences, not merely hash/cache behavior.

new_test_obligations: Production frontend -> TypedIR must materialize TopologyReadEffect as ClayCode-native value, not untyped side metadata.
Persist/reload a topology-scoped Hyperposition lowering certificate through UnifiedDB without semantic identity drift.
Reject a stale bound topology fingerprint before reuse/runtime realization.
Change an unbound topology plane and preserve a semantically valid cached/lowered result when generations remain valid.
Compare typed scoped fingerprints against a single coarse topology-generation counter; preserve NO_BENEFIT if simpler mechanism dominates.
Backend swap NATIVE_NARY <-> LATENT_FACTOR_STAR must preserve semantic relation identity while physical and topology-dependency identities remain explicit.
Restart/recovery must restore certificate and topology-read identity without prompt reconstruction.
hypothesis: Native ClayCode topology read effects can make Hyperposition lowering/cache validity precise without introducing a second semantic state architecture.
counterhypothesis: A single native execution/topology generation, already carried through the owner-fixed ClayCode state world, may dominate per-plane certificates on complexity and recovery while preserving equal safety.
